beats.text: A thirty-sheet bid set arrives. Keep the floor plan and the two electrical sheets.
Name the working sheet A-101 · First Floor Plan, then open it.
Check the scale against a printed dimension before counting anything.
Set up the devices to count, starting with the receptacles.
Duplex receptacles arrive set at 18 inches above the floor.
A single-pole light switch, set at 48 inches.
2x4 troffer light fixtures, at the ceiling.
Place the electrical panel and name it LP-1.
Create the conduit type: 3/4 inch EMT.
List the wires it carries: three #12 conductors and a ground.
Circuit 7 on panel LP-1: the north wall receptacles, 6 amps.
Chain from device to device. Each click adds the conduit and its 9.5 ft vertical drop.
Draw the home run back to the panel, square to the walls, and flag it.
Circuit 9: the south wall receptacles, wired the same way.
Circuit 11: the light fixtures and their switch.
The app totals the wire from the conduit, and checks conduit fill and voltage drop.
Hide the marks, then show them again, to check the room for anything missed.
Send the finished takeoff to the estimating app for pricing.
